leaves.criterion: Required fixture families exist with reviewed provenance/permissions, immutable hashes, correct origin labels and requirement mappings; catalog and negative validation cases pass.

Canonical contract tests are runnable against pinned shared-contracts artifacts and declared producer/consumer interfaces; missing canonical packages or required interfaces block the affected conformance criteria. No copied substitute schema may clear them.

The complete IE-04 happy path and key IE-05 failure/recovery/concurrency scenarios are defined and executable through the documented runner, with passing mandatory offline cases and explicit per-boundary blocked/mocked results where real execution is unavailable. Preserve original WP09 obligations via IE-05D.

The JEV corpus/split, labels, numeric policy register and deterministic/generative/JEV comparison methodology are frozen, validated and reviewed. Insufficient held-out samples, unresolved targets or missing actual receipts prevent promotion. GPT Image evidence validation has separate mock/recorded/gated profiles and concrete blockers.

Reporting schemas, machine-readable requirement export, canonical tracker update procedure, flake/rerun policy and sanitized evidence packaging/labeling rules are implemented and validated. Every mandatory requirement maps to a case/artifact or explicit blocker; no orphan tests, skipped-as-pass, required quarantine hidden as green, or forged live claims.

A clean pinned CI execution records exact integration/component/schema/fixture/config revisions and modes, preserves failures and cleanup evidence, and runs mandatory deterministic security/privacy regressions with zero authorization/leak/containment failures among executed cases. Any required owner boundary not executed remains blocked for product acceptance; zero executed tests is not a pass.

Release reviewer records two separate decisions: repository verification-tooling readiness and integrated product/provider acceptance. Tooling readiness requires all mandatory leaf deliverables and runnable offline checks below; an honest blocked provider profile can satisfy scaffolding only. Product/live criteria remain blocked/unverified until their exact required-mode upstream evidence is supplied. This issue may close for tooling readiness only with a linked limitations/blocker record; closure must never auto-verify EVAL/SPN criteria.

Track first-run and every rerun result with run/parent IDs, unchanged pin/fixture/config hashes, attempt index, seed and rationale. Never overwrite a failure with a later pass; report flaky, consistently failed and blocked separately.

Define bounded rerun policy: at most two diagnostic offline reruns with identical pins/inputs after the original failure; no automatic rerun for authorization/safety failures, live provider calls or ambiguous dispatch. Live reruns require explicit budget/current authority and owner reconciliation through IE-05C.

Require flake records to include case/requirement, frequency denominator, last good/bad revisions, failure signature, owner, linked remediation issue, quarantine reason/expiry and reproduction command. Mandatory quarantined/skipped cases remain blocked for release and cannot improve pass rate silently.

Separate benchmark stochastic variation from infrastructure flakes using declared repeats/statistics; preserve all samples. Document minimal reproduction export, local replay, CI triage routing and conditions for removing quarantine.

Define a versioned evidence index linking requirement/case/run ID, actual producing component and SHA, timestamps/original cutoff, provider mode, origin class, artifact digest, sanitized reviewer-accessible reference, permission/redaction review and limitations. Preserve failed/pending/blocked entries without creating fake artifacts.

Support Neatlogs runtime/recovery traces and comparable improvement, Entire development checkpoints/repository graph tied to code revisions, JEV request/decision receipts with question/candidate IDs, GPT Image generation/edit outputs, and acceptance-run summaries with exact manifests. Require producer artifacts; wrappers, screenshots of mocks and architecture docs do not establish sponsor use.

Validate reference accessibility for intended reviewers, digest/provenance joins, missing/stale references and honest claim labels. Keep live, sandbox-derived, recorded and synthetic sources distinct and unknown/estimated financial values explicit.

Sanitize credentials, customer/account details, prompts/source bodies where restricted, metadata and signed access URLs; preserve original private artifacts in approved storage and package safe derivatives. Run IE-11B leakage checks before export.

Produce an offline sample package from clearly synthetic artifacts and a missing-provider/sponsor blocker register. Preserve CFO.ai FinancialSummary/business-plan handoff to cost-intelligence/marketing; a generic export is not proof of an actual CFO.ai plan. Submission narrative/publication and sponsor account setup remain with their owners.

Use two synthetic tenants/projects and roles. Swap tenant/project/order/design/artifact IDs, source refs and correlation IDs at APIs, queued jobs, cache reuse, downloads and dashboards; require trusted server scope and no cross-tenant reads/writes or observable private data.

Replay, forge, revoke and expire approval references; mutate selected version/hash/facts, permission grants or principal. Confirm app-owned verification rejects unauthorized/stale approval and creative/print/fulfillment cannot hand off or dispatch. Reuse semantic fixtures from IE-03B; do not build a second verifier.

Exercise malformed/truncated/polyglot/oversized images and SVG with scripts, event handlers, external references, embedded active content, dangerous links and malformed XML. Ensure owner-provided asset handling rejects/quarantines safely, never executes active content or fetches unexpected resources, and rechecks approval/rights.

Seed fake secret/PII canaries in requests, error payloads, usage events and provider responses; scan exported reports, traces, screenshots/metadata, fixture history and evidence indexes. Require sanitization and safe reference-only outputs, with useful correlation retained. Never seed actual credentials/customer data.

Test access revocation between collection and evidence read/export, and validate reviewer access without widening artifact visibility. Require zero deterministic authorization/secret-leak failures; preserve sanitized diagnostic evidence for failures.

Create controlled URL cases for unsupported schemes, loopback/private/link-local/metadata destinations, IPv4/IPv6 encodings, DNS rebinding, redirect-to-private and redirect loops. Verify each resolved destination/redirect is checked by the owning retrieval boundary, with time/size/redirect/resource limits and no private target reached.

Use an isolated test network with mock metadata/internal endpoints and authoritative egress capture; never probe real private infrastructure. Distinguish unit URL parser evidence from actual boundary/redirect/egress verification.

Inject hostile instructions into HTML, JSON-LD, email/text, screenshots/OCR and asset metadata. Verify content stays untrusted evidence and cannot modify budgets, tool allowlists, tenant scope, question policy, approval state, credentials or downstream instructions with authority.

Assert rejection/quarantine/uncertainty is preserved in research package, JEV routing and creative handoff with sanitized provenance; no unauthorized network request, privileged action or secret appears in traces/artifacts. Deterministic containment assertions require 100% pass.

Define separate mock-fixture, recorded-example replay and sandbox/live-gated profiles. A recorded response retains original provenance/date but a replay is offline; a synthetic image or mock adapter cannot satisfy provider integration criteria. If the provider has no sandbox, explicitly record controlled live mode rather than inventing one.

Validate through creative-engine owned adapter results: generation and edit inputs/permission refs, exact provider/model/config and adapter revision, request/response or provider receipt identity when available, output artifact hashes/media properties, immutable DesignVersion parent/usage references and actual/unknown usage. Never require fictional IDs/usage fields the provider does not supply.

Exercise malformed/empty output, unsupported settings, timeout/ambiguous dispatch, moderation/refusal, missing usage, duplicate response and cancellation/late completion through declared mock/recorded cases. Assert structured result/error and preservation of cost uncertainty.

Publish a gated preflight/runbook with credential presence, account eligibility, approved budget cap, allowed modes/operations, asset permission, endpoint/model version, cleanup and stop conditions. Capture blocked-by-credentials/budget/interface reasons per criterion with owner and next action; do not silently downgrade or dispatch as part of triage.

For approved live evidence later, link original generation plus one structured revision/edit, actual output bytes/hash, usage/unknown status, request timestamps, correlation and exact approved handoff. Apply owner-defined quality rubric separately from provider connectivity; one live call does not prove the whole creative release.

Execute deterministic rules, the pinned JEV candidate via agent-harness DecisionPort, and a pinned generative baseline on identical frozen held-out inputs. Record candidate/model, question/prompt/config digests, seeds, temperature where applicable, revision, environment/mode, order/warmup/concurrency, sample size and repeated-trial policy; use existing owner runners/adapters, not new JEV transport.

Report per-question and per-stratum TP/FP/FN, macro-F1, precision/recall, critical false negatives, abstention and coverage, calibration where scores are meaningful, p50/p95 latency, total and downstream cost per successful outcome, unknown-cost rate and failures. Use paired family/bootstrap 95% confidence intervals and raw per-case results; never pool away a bad safety slice.

Freeze numeric thresholds before evaluation with specialist owners. Starting proposals from EI #15: relevance recall >=.98 overall/>=.95 language-noise slices; identity precision >=.97; conflict precision >=.95; accepted support correctness >=.98; source refs 100%; no-answer recall >=.95; adequate-evidence coverage >=.60. All deterministic safety cases must pass 100%. These are proposals until ratified, not claims of achieved scores.

Starting CE #8 proposals: routing macro-F1 >=.90, auto-route precision >=.98, each intent recall >=.90, abstention <=.20; inspection defect recall >=.95, false-repair <=.05, abstention <=.25; JEV within .02 macro-F1 of best baseline, >=20% lower total cost/success than generative baseline, p95 <=2 seconds; safety 100%. Source-type/injection and any uncovered question require explicit numeric per-class targets from agent #6; unresolved EI latency/currency budget/tradeoff blocks promotion.

Promotion requires ratified complete target register, adequate adjudicated samples, zero deterministic safety regressions, threshold and uncertainty-rule compliance, compatible pinned interfaces, actual required-mode receipts and total-cost evidence. Preserve negative findings, owner decision and rollback comparison; mock/recorded runs validate methodology only and cannot promote live routing.

Catalog labeled source-type classification, passage relevance, event identity/conflict triage, injection signals, creative intent routing and repair/quality triage. Record versioned question/option IDs, expected label or allowed abstention, evidence rationale, provenance/permission, language/noise/ambiguity strata and owning requirement. Specialist question semantics stay with event-intelligence and creative-engine.

Use independent labeling by two reviewers with adjudication/disagreement records for ambiguous cases; retain hard negatives, conflicting events, noisy/multilingual sources, malicious instructions, Noul/no-answer and cases where no repair is appropriate. Exclude unnecessary personal/private content.

Freeze dataset/annotation/question-schema digests and disjoint calibration/development versus held-out evaluation splits by source/event/template family, not row randomization. Deduplicate semantically related variants across splits; forbid prompt/threshold tuning on held-out labels and version any later changes.

Reconcile minimum dataset sizes with upstream policies: EI proposed at least 120 calibration +240 held-out, at least 20 held-out per family and 40 non-English across four languages; creative proposed 160 routing calibration +400 held-out across eight intents plus 160 safety cases, and 56 inspection calibration +140 held-out across seven classes. Record any agreed change with rationale before evaluation; smoke fixtures do not satisfy these targets.

Provide a corpus validator for required families, permissions, labels/adjudication, class/stratum coverage, split leakage and immutable hashes. Reference upstream exports with provenance rather than copying unreviewed data. Publish reviewer-access rules and an explicit pending list if collection/adjudication is incomplete.

Extend the correlated synthetic journey through owner-provided deterministic personalization/print preflight, bundle hash verification, sandbox quote, explicit synthetic purchase authorization, submission/callback and financial report. Reject invalid dimensions/bleed/resolution, missing fonts or mismatched hashes and verify exact personalized text.

Prove quote does not incur expense or submit an order; mutation of quantity, destination, bundle hash, currency or authorized amount invalidates purchase authorization. Reuse IE-05C duplicate/ambiguous supplier observations and prohibit real purchase.

Consume cost-intelligence expected financial fixture outputs for FIN-01 attempt metering; FIN-02 duplicate observations; FIN-03 distinct billed attempts; FIN-04 unknown usage; FIN-05 $1→$1.10 reconciliation; FIN-06 aggregate invoice coverage without double counting; FIN-07 subcent precision; FIN-08 shared research allocation conservation; FIN-09 sale/fee/refund/tax/credit/payout/reimbursement classification; and FIN-10 billing-mode isolation. Exercise public ingestion/projection interfaces, not a second ledger.

DASH-01: compare dashboard totals/drilldowns to the same period/currency/mode projection. DASH-02: show unknown/estimated/unreconciled data. DASH-03: enforce member reads versus authorized commands with actor audit. DASH-04: reconcile FinancialSummary definitions, period, assumptions, coverage and sources.

Map each original P0 criterion to exact case/output; preserve blocking upstream dependencies. BUD-04 remains P1/non-v1 and LIVE-01–03 remain Production/non-v1, explicitly excluded from this v1 verification gate rather than erased or marked verified.

Simulate provider acceptance followed by timeout, worker lease expiry and missing completion/usage data. Retain unknown/estimated cost and conservative financial hold; reconcile the existing provider identity before any owner-authorized redispatch. Never invent zero cost or declare cancellation means no charge.

Build explicit identity cases: replayed observation keeps event identity; safe transport redelivery of the same provider operation does not create a second logical effect; a new billable attempt has its own identity/cost; deliberate user reissue creates a new operation linked to the original and requires current authority/budget. No unsafe automatic reissue after ambiguous send.

Lose usage before local persistence, during outbox publish and after consumer receipt; restore/replay through owner interfaces and verify eventual at-least-once delivery with idempotent effect. Matching direct usage and trace observations must not double count. Distinct billed retries must retain both expenses.

Reconcile an explicit $1.00 estimate to $1.10 confirmed cost with traceable adjustment, settle/release only justified capacity, preserve unexplained differences and isolate actual paid test costs from synthetic sales.

For supplier ambiguity/repeated callback use sandbox or explicit simulation and inspect one intended supplier order/no duplicate transition. No paid fulfillment or real purchase is performed by this suite by default.

Inject JEV timeout before send and after dispatch, rate limit, provider error, malformed/truncated response, unknown question/option ID, invalid enum, NaN/infinite/out-of-range score, invalid distribution and missing receipt/usage. Check typed outcomes and no invented confidence for Noul/no-answer.

Verify bounded retries and deterministic safe fallback/escalation per owner policy; no multiplicative SDK-plus-harness retries, unapproved additional provider calls, authority expansion or silent conversion of absent decisions into facts.

Exercise unsupported/hostile URLs, redirect rejection, oversized content and access-denied sources via controlled fixtures; preserve uncertainty and rejection provenance without unsafe fetch or tool dispatch. Detailed network isolation is in IE-11A.

Use conflicting dates/venues, same-name different occurrence, duplicate sources, stale evidence and multilingual/noisy passages. Require material conflicts and field-level provenance to survive research package and brief handoff; unsupported facts must not become auto-approved identity.

Record question/config/candidate IDs, classification outcome, fallback decision and all attempt/usage references with exact pins/modes. An unavailable production boundary is blocked; a stubbed failure proves only the defined fixture behavior.

Kill/restart the owning worker immediately before dispatch, after a completed durable step, after external success before checkpoint, and during evidence/usage publication. Resume through the real harness interface; assert no repeated committed step and preserve unresolved dispatch ambiguity for reconciliation.

Replay identical user actions/events and race two workers on the same operation. Assert one logical action and legitimate immutable version history, stable redelivery ID, preserved distinct billable attempts and no double order/expense or lost update.

Cancel before dispatch and while a provider call is in flight; verify no new work after cancellation, late outputs do not publish as the selected design, already incurred costs remain recorded, and uncertain cost holds remain until reconciled.

Use synchronized barriers to contend for remaining shared project budget and the same design parent/head. Verify atomic reservation acceptance, capacity conservation, conflict/branch handling, consumption and unused release without exceeding the limit.

Bound fault recovery by configured attempts, wall time and cost; collect authoritative checkpoints/version states and teardown. Test hooks belong to owning repositories; missing hooks block the relevant case.

Define one fictional event/tenant/project with safe URL/HTML and permission-approved assets. Execute URL intake → sourced EventIntelligencePackage → CreativeBrief → initial DesignVersion → structured revision with immutable parent/child → app-authorized exact selected-version handoff → evidence summary.

Use an exact release manifest covering app, shared-contracts, agent-harness, event-intelligence, creative-engine, cost-intelligence and integration-evals, plus any actual handoff consumer. Record SHAs, contract versions, fixture digests, provider/model modes and environment; refuse drifting refs.

Assert material facts have source/uncertainty references, brief preserves permissions/conflicts, design versions retain separate hashes and usage/parent links, revision preserves unaffected fields, and approval binds selected version/hash, event facts and asset rights. Handoff bytes/digest must match approved output.

Correlate logical operation, transport and billable attempt IDs, JEV decisions/receipts where present, image outputs, unknown/confirmed usage and cost attribution with sanitized trace/evidence references. Verify summary claims match actual modes.

Provide offline mocked/recorded rehearsal and gated real-boundary execution profiles. Missing canonical interfaces, app approval authority, JEV/GPT access or budget yields exact blocked criteria. IE-04 ends at approval-bound handoff; full original EVAL-01 commerce/financial acceptance additionally requires IE-05D and may not be marked verified by this slice alone.

Consume the integration assembly manifest from getticketstub.com and validate full immutable commit SHAs for every participating repository, contract/fixture digests, runtime/tool versions, dependency lockfiles and image digests where used. Do not resolve main/latest or treat open-PR claims as accepted releases.

Verify fetched commit identity and clean checkout, save actual resolved tree/revisions, and fail on omitted/mismatched pins, dirty releases or unsupported compatibility combinations. Pin integration-evals itself and archive the manifest digest with each result.

Create deterministic offline PR jobs for catalog, report/schema validators and mock suites; select component contract/scenario suites through a checked-in coverage map. Use isolated workspaces and cache keys including all relevant pins/modes; reject missing mandatory suite selection.

Provide manually gated sandbox/live jobs with per-provider preflight, explicit credential/budget authorization, spend caps and redacted configuration. Missing credentials/budget yields blocked; real-provider failures never fall back silently to mocks. No secrets are exposed to untrusted PR execution.
Archive sanitized results and reproduction instructions on failures and passes; document pin-update review and old/new compatibility comparison. Verify cleanup/cancellation and artifact retention.

Define versioned run and case result schemas: run/case/requirement IDs, UTC timestamps, exact integration and dependency SHAs, manifest digest, environment/runtime/config fingerprints, fixture digests, provider modes/model versions, observed outcome, duration/cost/unknowns, evidence refs, limitations and blocker owner. Produce JSON plus a human-readable report and CI-compatible test results.

Separate execution outcome (passed/failed/skipped/error), criterion status (canonical planned/in_progress/blocked/verified/deferred), and evidence class/provider mode. Display pending as canonical planned; mocked means mock evidence and cannot replace verified status for a required real boundary. Recorded replay and missing credentials never become live proof. Preserve failures and never convert a skipped mandatory case to pass.

Export requirement→case→run→artifact→implementation issue/dependency mappings for IE-01–IE-12 and all relevant original acceptance IDs. Validate no orphan tests, missing mandatory requirements, dangling references or unverifiable claims; list P1/Production exclusions explicitly.

Keep planning/acceptance-checklist.json and Markdown authoritative and consistent, preserving IDs, priorities, owners and original verification/evidence text. Implement a reviewed evidence-update procedure; do not auto-mark criteria verified from issue closure, docs or mocks.

Schema-test mixed-provider runs, unknown costs, blocked credentials, partial runs, stale pins, failed cases and sanitized reports. Human summary must explain exactly which criteria remain pending, blocked or only mocked.

Build a requirement-owned semantic matrix for wrong tenant/project/resource owner, inaccessible source references, forged or invalid IDs, unsupported controls, privileged actions and privacy-sensitive payloads. Validate at API, queued job and artifact-read boundaries.

Change design version/hash, parent, selected artwork, event facts/package revision or approved asset rights after approval; require typed stale/revoked rejection and no downstream handoff. Replay and forged references must never authorize a fresh output. Consume approval authority from the app-owned verifier.

Assert producers export only permitted fields and consumers recheck current authorization/rights. Correlation IDs, payload tenant claims, model output and a fixture approval object are not authority. Verify cross-tenant and revoked-source references cannot be resolved.

Capture ownership and write-path observations demonstrating one authoritative writer per record. Keep local contract validation and server authorization separate, and fail the case if a correct error still causes a persisted unauthorized artifact or billable dispatch.

Import the exact published shared-contracts schema/validator/fixture revision; fail blocked if missing, never silently invent an equivalent schema. Maintain explicit supported-version and additive/unknown-field policies agreed by the canonical owner.

Cover ProjectRequest (app→harness), EventIntelligencePackage (research→harness/creative), CreativeBrief (creative→harness/image path), DesignControlSchema (creative→UI), DesignVersion (creative→app/print), ProductionBundle (print→app/fulfillment), FulfillmentQuote (fulfillment→app), OrderAuthorization (app→harness/fulfillment), UsageEvent (metered modules→cost), BudgetReservation (cost→metered clients), FinancialSummary (cost→dashboard/export), and EvaluationEvidence (evals→submission hub). Record every concrete pinned producer and consumer.

Execute positive, missing required field, invalid identifier, unsupported enum, older compatible/incompatible version, unknown additive field and unsupported major-version fixtures at both production and consumption boundaries. Require typed actionable rejection with no side effects for invalid inputs.

Check common envelope version, stable delivery event ID, trusted tenant/project scope, correlation (never authority), producer/build revision, UTC timestamps, environment/billing mode and source refs; required-versus-optional fields follow the actual published schema. Unknown IDs remain explicit unknown/omitted per schema.

Verify deterministic serialization/hash rules, exact decimal/currency and subcent amounts, and separation of logical operation, billable attempt, transport attempt, provider request and ingestion IDs. Export requirement-linked per-boundary compatibility results.

Extend the boundary inventory to all interfaces in the newly scoped canonical backlog: ResearchRequest; research correction/invalidation events; DecisionPort Choice/Score/Noul and DecisionReceipt; external ApprovalReference/ApprovalReceipt; ArtifactHandoffManifest; typed errors/partial failures; async status/cancellation/resume; and normalized fulfillment status. Pin producer/consumer pairs and test version/error/privacy/replay behavior. Resolve conflicting local Score/envelope/ResearchPackage alias proposals through shared-contracts owner decisions before marking compatibility verified.

Provide versioned event URLs and inert HTML snapshots, valid/malformed/ambiguous JSON-LD, screenshots/image inputs, synthetic text/email evidence and brand assets; include conflicts, unknown facts, hostile instructions, unsupported URLs and access-restricted content.

Provide creative briefs, immutable parent/child design versions, structured revision commands, exact version/hash/fact-bound approval references, missing/stale/forged approvals and approved/denied/expired asset-permission examples.

Provide valid and malformed payloads (missing fields, invalid IDs, enum/version mismatches, wrong tenant/owner, sensitive data) plus usage/metering events for duplicate delivery, distinct billable attempts, unknown usage, estimates/reconciliation, subcent costs and billing modes.

Include minimally one positive and one negative case for each listed family, expected result and owning requirement. Keep asset bytes safe or quarantined; reference active SVG security cases as inert input to controlled test endpoints.

Pin upstream fixture/schema revisions and content hashes; document regeneration, semantic expectations and catalog validation. Do not assert synthetic approval objects are authentic runtime authorizations.

Define a versioned catalog with stable fixture ID, digest, media type, source reference, collection/generation date, creator/owner, permission/license basis, tenant scope, redaction record, retention/revocation rule, requirement IDs, expected outputs and supported modes.

Require origin labels synthetic, recorded, sandbox-derived or live evidence. Keep origin separate from execution provider mode, estimated/confirmed cost and criterion state; a recorded real response replay is not a fresh live call. Mixed runs label each artifact.

Reject fixtures with missing permission/provenance, secrets, unnecessary personal data, broken hashes or unowned requirements. Use fictional reserved domains and fake identities by default; keep hostile payloads inert and never render active content during catalog validation.

Document restricted artifact storage/access, sanitized derivatives and reviewer access; remove or quarantine revoked material without losing a tombstone/digest audit. Explicitly prohibit redistributing customer/private sponsor data without suitable permission.

Publish an execution ADR and runnable thin verification entrypoint using the integration workspace supplied by getticketstub.com; document setup, discovery, isolation, seed/clock control, timeout, teardown, failure injection and read-only state observations. Do not implement domain business logic in the harness.

Expose local-developer and CI execution contexts independently from provider mode. Support mock-only (offline, no provider secrets/egress), recorded replay (offline provenance), and explicitly gated sandbox/live checks. A run may have mixed per-provider modes, all recorded. Local mode supports chosen pinned components and reports any missing boundary.

Preflight each required dependency, credential availability (boolean only), configured endpoint, explicit budget authority, cap, provider mode and cleanup support. Missing prerequisites yield blocked with owner/reason; an intentional unselected criterion remains pending. No silent fallback from sandbox/live to mocks and no paid calls by default.

Require every case to declare owning requirement IDs, input fixture IDs, component interfaces, expected invariant, provider capabilities and artifact outputs. Reject orphan tests and unsupported mode combinations before dispatch.

Run against isolated tenant/project namespaces; use supported APIs/adapters and fault hooks owned by component repos; capture exit status and always perform bounded cleanup. Publish exact runnable examples for local, CI, mock-only and gated provider execution.
